name: Improved Doctrine
summary: Doctrine Improved Feature Shock Trooper Your Shock Trooper bonus becomes +1d8. Marksman Your first ranged attack each turn ignores light cover. Sergeant Allies benefiting from your Sergeant doctrine add +1d4 to their first failed fear or Suppression save each combat.
